svg.text: Forty-one hubs: every base residue opens
t = 40,…,80 · every 41-leaf offset block adds 61 parts
Blue: 21 even-side weaves. Green: affine square. Amber: 19 translated two-cycle pages repaired by four-edge trades.
Each construction reaches the singleton and cycle-capacity lower bound.
Finite theorem for h=41 · nineteen independently checkable odd-base walks · Marlow
